proposals.before: In the first year of Taishi under Emperor Ming, he was transferred to Left Army Staff Officer of the Ministry of Rites, General Who Conquers, and Governor of Southern Donghai.
proposals.after: In the first year of Taishi under Emperor Ming, he was transferred to Left Chief Clerk to the Minister of Education (Situ), Champion General, and Governor of Southern Donghai.
proposals.reason: 司徒 is Situ (Minister of Education), not the Ministry of Rites; 冠軍將軍 is Champion General.

proposals.before: When affairs were settled, he was made Supervisor of the Secretariat, with his original title as Commissioner with the Golden Grandee's insignia and ceremonial staff equal to the Three Dukes, heading the Ministry of Rites; Yang Province was dissolved as his headquarters—he firmly refused to move.
proposals.after: When affairs were settled, he was made Supervisor of the Secretariat, with his original title as Commissioner with ceremonial staff equal to the Three Dukes, heading the Minister of Education (Situ) post; the Yang Province headquarters building was assigned as his office—he firmly refused to move.
proposals.reason: 領司徒 means heading the Situ post, not Ministry of Rites; 以揚州解為府 means using the Yang Province office as his headquarters.

proposals.before: When Emperor Shun took the throne, he was moved to Supervisor of the Secretariat, with his posts as Minister of Rites and Palace Attendant unchanged.
proposals.after: When Emperor Shun took the throne, he was moved to Supervisor of the Secretariat, with his posts as Minister of Education (Situ) and Palace Attendant unchanged.
proposals.reason: 司徒 is Situ, not Minister of Rites.

proposals.before: At the time the Prince of Qi entered and garrisoned the court hall; Bing's younger paternal uncle Yun, Commandant of the Army, went on duty in the Chancellery, Boxing served as palace guard, and Huang Hui and the other generals all led troops out to Xinting.
proposals.after: At the time the Prince of Qi entered and garrisoned the court hall; Bing's younger paternal cousin Yun, the Commander-in-Chief, went on duty in the Chancellery; Boxing served as Direct Attendant of the Pavilion; and Huang Hui and the other generals all led troops out to Xinting.
proposals.reason: 從父弟 means younger paternal cousin, not uncle; 領軍將軍 is Commander-in-Chief; 直閣 is Direct Attendant.

proposals.before: At the time the Prince of Qi entered and garrisoned the court hall; Bing's father's younger brother Commander-in-Chief Yun entered the Gate Down headquarters; Boxing was Direct Attendant; Huang Hui and the various generals all led armies out to Xinting.
proposals.after: At the time the Prince of Qi entered and garrisoned the court hall; Bing's younger paternal cousin Commander-in-Chief Yun entered duty in the Chancellery; Boxing was Direct Attendant; Huang Hui and the various generals all led armies out to Xinting.
proposals.reason: 從父弟 is paternal cousin, not father's younger brother.

proposals.before: I alone received the late emperor's entrustment and originally meant to repay with my life; today I should die with Protector General Chu for the altars of state!"
proposals.after: I, an orphaned son, received the late emperor's entrustment and originally meant to repay with my life; today I should die with Protector General Chu for the altars of state!
proposals.reason: 孤子 is the self-reference of a son in mourning, not merely "I alone".

decisions.reason: s0101 轉司徒左長史，冠軍將軍 names Left Chief Clerk under the Situ and Champion General; the before wrongly makes these Ministry of Rites staff and a 'General Who Conquers'.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 轉司徒左長史，冠軍將軍

decisions.reason: s0051 領司徒，以揚州解為府 is concurrent Situ and assigning the Yang Province office as headquarters; the before invents Ministry of Rites and wrongly dissolves Yang Province, and 'Golden Grandee's insignia' is not in 開府儀同三司.
s0111 司徒、侍中如故 keeps the Situ and Palace Attendant posts unchanged; rendering 司徒 as Minister of Rites is a real office error and the proposed Situ wording is accurate.
s0063 秉從父弟領軍將軍韞…伯興為直閣 makes Yun Bing's younger paternal cousin and 領軍將軍, and Boxing 直閣; uncle, Commandant of the Army, and palace guard misread kinship and titles.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 秉從父弟領軍將軍韞入直門下省，伯興為直閣

decisions.reason: 從父弟 is younger paternal cousin, not father's younger brother (叔父/從父); the literal before invents that uncle link, and the proposed cousin wording with 入直 restored is accurate.
孤子 is the bereaved-son self-reference, not 'I alone'; the before invents exclusivity absent from the Chinese, and 'orphaned son' restores the conventional mourning self-designation.
